propositions: CodeQL reports two high-severity alerts (81, 82) on lines 249-250 of test_llm_fallback_chain.py for incomplete URL substring sanitization using startswith() prefix checks
The test assertions use startswith() on URL strings which would incorrectly pass for attacker-controlled hosts sharing the prefix (e.g., https://fallback.test.evil.example/)
The fix replaces startswith() substring checks with exact equality comparison of parsed URL origins (scheme, netloc tuple) via urllib.parse.urlsplit
The endpoint constant must be single-sourced to _FALLBACK_ENDPOINT so configured and asserted values cannot drift
After fix, the test still correctly fails if the fallback entry falls back to provider default instead of configured endpoint
No CodeQL alerts remain dismissed or suppressed; the code is changed such that CodeQL re-scan reports zero open alerts of this rule
